name: @fasaled/muin
description: Explore a PDF’s internals from the terminal — objects, streams, page tree, and cross-references — as a navigable graph. Interactive TUI, one-shot commands, and an MCP server for agents.
author: Francisco Sánchez <fa.sl@live.com>

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target node --format esm --banner '#!/usr/bin/env node' && bun build ../core/src/worker/session-worker.ts --outfile dist/session-worker.js --target node --format esm && mkdir -p vendor && cp -R ../../vendor/qpdf vendor/
